*PharmaCraft Daily - 10 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Cardiovascular)
Q: Digoxin acts by inhibiting?
Ans: Na-K ATPase
Why: Digoxin inhibits the Na-K ATPase pump, raising intracellular calcium and increasing cardiac contractility (positive inotrope).

🩺 *NEET PG* (Autacoids and NSAIDs)
Q: Selective COX-2 inhibitor among these?
Ans: Celecoxib
Why: Celecoxib is a selective COX-2 inhibitor with less GI toxicity but increased cardiovascular risk.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Esketamine nasal spray is approved for?
Ans: Treatment-resistant depression
Why: Esketamine, an NMDA antagonist, is approved for treatment-resistant depression; it acts rapidly compared to SSRIs.

🌍 *FMGE* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Diazepam enhances the action of which neurotransmitter?
Ans: GABA
Why: Benzodiazepines enhance GABA-A activity (increase frequency of chloride channel opening), causing sedation and anxiolysis.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Research Methodology)
Q: Number needed to treat (NNT) is calculated as?
Ans: 1/absolute risk reduction
Why: NNT = 1 / absolute risk reduction. It is the number of patients treated to prevent one additional adverse outcome.
